finding.consequence: For a new queued epoch different from old active_epoch, parent abort during any pending edge is ignored and can allow descriptor commit after the parent cancels.
finding.recommended_small_fix: Expose/capture reserved owner tag on acceptance, retain last_epoch/epoch_seen update only on successful commit; document public reserved versus private admitted semantics. Test actual parent abort at every pending edge.
finding.requirement: Every accepted pending scratch owner must be canceled by the actual parent wiring before admission/physical effects.
finding.source_evidence: packed_scratch cancel selects queued_epoch in BEGIN_PLAN/BEGIN_COMMIT; active_epoch stays old until BEGIN_COMMIT. Existing parent wires abort_epoch(store_epoch) and active_epoch(store_epoch). Parent store_abort=start||abort_packet||(running&&packet_error!=0).

other_source_observations: Descriptor capture and existing BEGIN_PLAN mature bit provide three real candidate edges: base and flags E+1, dependent plans E+2, consume E+3.
Modulo32 arithmetic widths and original accepted-edge algebra checks retained.
A pending descriptor owns no physical request, dense result or coefficient eligibility; existing response/debt overrides remain higher priority.
IDLE cursor clear happens on acceptance before preparation, and prepared V114 prefetch payload gets its existing later consuming warm-up.
